note: Rewritten from the English description on p. 22 of Banks & Snyder 1920 (Revision of the Nearctic Termites, Bull. U.S.N.M. 108); the OCR of that paper runs one word per line and has been restored to the original word order, the numbers being reliable. The original describes the soldier only and explicitly records The winged adult is unknown, hence no section for that caste; measurement units in mm are kept verbatim. Length of pronotum (at corners) is the original wording.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier total length 7.50—7.75 mm, head length about 1.5 times the head width, antennae 13-segmented; mandibles black and shining, about as long as the head width, the right mandible with 2 short pointed marginal teeth near the base, the lower two-thirds of the left mandible with 3 rather broad blunt teeth, the middle tooth broadest and molar-like; pronotum wider than the head, anterior margin without teeth.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown (pale chestnut), darker anteriorly, 1.5 times as long as wide, the sides parallel to slightly concave, with a few scattered pale yellow long hairs; the anterior part of the head sloping forwards, with a V-shaped depression. Antennae pale yellow, 13-segmented, reaching the tips of the mandibles when crossed over them, covered with short hairs; segment 3 yellowish brown, nearly clavate, slightly shorter than segments 4 and 5 together. Eyes transparent white, circular to oval; ocelli visible above the eye spots. Labrum yellowish brown, wider than long, the tip almost rounded, with long hairs. Mandibles black and shining, reddish brown at the base, about as long as the head width; broad at the base, pointed and incurved at the tip; the right mandible with 2 short, pointed, nearly equal marginal teeth near the base, the lower two-thirds of the left mandible with 3 rather broad blunt marginal teeth, the middle tooth broadest (molar-like). Postmentum slender, the anterior part more than twice as wide as the middle. Pronotum dirty white with pale yellow, wider than the head, less than twice as wide as long, anterior margin rounded and rather deeply concave, the anterior margin not toothed as in K. marginipennis; sides smoothly rounded and sloping backwards, posterior margin convex. Legs pale yellow, tarsi yellow; legs short, the hind femur swollen, with short hairs. Abdomen dirty white-grey with yellow, with pale yellow long and short hairs. Soldier measurements (in mm): total body length 7.50—7.75; head length (including the mandibles) 3.3—3.7; head length (to the anterior margin of the head) 2.2—2.4; head length (to the tip of the labrum) 2.6; head width 1.40—1.55; left mandible length 1.35—1.40; pronotum length (at corners) 1.10—1.15; pronotum width 1.6—1.7; hind tibia length 1.1.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate unknown (The winged adult is unknown), so there is no description of that caste. Type locality Ortega, Florida, USA; holotype soldier Cat. No. 22359, in the U.S.N.M.
